title: Response views
brief: The response island: Body with Pretty / Raw / Preview (HTML, image, unsupported type), Headers, Cookies table with masked secrets, Tests results, script Console, Timeline, search in response, size and time. Built on the bolt-v2 shell.

artboards.title: One row of views
artboards.tradeoff: Every view one click away and the format sits next to the body it changes; six segments crowd the row and a Body-only second row makes the content jump when switching views

artboards.title: Script tabs, format in the bottom bar
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to bolt-v2/01-main and separates what the server sent from what scripts said; the format switch lives far from the view switch, and a failed test hides behind a tab

artboards.title: Body with an inspector
artboards.tradeoff: Body and a failing test or cookie are visible together; the body loses 500 px, so long JSON lines wrap sooner, and the cookies table becomes stacked cards

artboards.title: Narrow pane
artboards.tradeoff: Nothing leaves the pane at any width and every tab and view stays reachable; the second line makes the views row taller in a narrow column, the buttons lose their labels under 360 px, and a hidden chip needs a sideways scroll (no scrollbar is drawn)
